label: to review
Proposed: Franken
research: Dochnahl, p. 104, calls Michael von Rosenberg the local Vizedom and reports that the elector renewed his father’s fief at the Haardter Burg. This is the medieval Burg Winzingen at Haardt, distinct from the Wolfsburg mentioned as demolished (https://www.neustadt.eu/index.php?FID=2636.68150.1&ModID=7&object=tx%7C2636.68150.1). The Winzingen purchase by Georg (1535-10-09.json), the Boxberg quitclaim explicitly naming Michael as Jörg’s son (1545-12-11.json), and the 1561 settlement naming both as former Winzingen holders (1561-07-24_2.json) strongly identify the Vizedom as Michael of the Boxberg-Schweigern branch (Franken). The 1512 Schultheiß held a Wolfsberg fief. His connection to the Vizedom remains open, since the renewal here concerns the fief at Haardt. The Winzingen and Boxberg records give positive family evidence beyond the regional surname parallels with the Schenk and Mönch families.

entries.source: Dochnahl, Chronik von Neustadt an der Haardt, p. 104
entries.german: Weil das Wolfsberger Schloß demolirt war, so erhält Michael von Rosenberg, Vicedom dahier, die Haardter Burg, und der Kurfürst erneuert demselben das seinem Vater ertheilte Lehen daselbst.
entries.english: Because Wolfsberg Castle had been demolished, Michael von Rosenberg, Vicedom zu Neustadt, receives Haardt Castle, and the Elector renews for him the fief there that had been granted to his father.

facts.content: received Burg Winzingen at Haardt when the elector renewed the fief there previously granted to his father.
